title: SignRot: LLM Quantization with Massive Outlier-Aware Sign-Adjusted Rotation
abstract: arXiv:2611.16502v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While quantization compresses LLMs and accelerates inference, outlier activations impede efficient low-bit representation. In particular, massive outliers cause substantial performance degradation. Although rotation-based methods that rely on randomized Hadamard transforms for online inference aim to mitigate this, they can produce fragmented distributions with empty bins when a massive outlier dominates a token's activation. This fragmentation severely undermines uniform quantization performance. Moreover, massive outliers concentrate in the down-projection input, where the preceding nonlinearity requires the rotation to be applied at inference time. This constraint prevents training-based approaches such as SpinQuant from learning the online rotation at this position, as a learned dense matrix cannot use the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform and would require a full matrix multiplication during inference. translated_title: SignRot：面向大语言模型量化的大规模离群值感知符号调整旋转方法
translated_abstract: 虽然量化能够压缩大语言模型并加速推理，但离群值激活阻碍了高效的低比特表示。尤其是大规模离群值会导致显著的性能下降。尽管基于随机化Hadamard变换的旋转方法通过在线推理力求缓解该问题，但当大规模离群值主导某个token的激活时，这些方法会产生带有空桶的碎片化分布。这种碎片化严重破坏了均匀量化的性能。此外，大规模离群值集中在下投影的输入处，其前方的非线性要求旋转必须在推理时进行。这一约束使得SpinQuant等基于训练的方法无法在该位置学习在线旋转，因为学习到的稠密矩阵无法使用快速Walsh-Hadamard变换，并且在推理时需要执行完整的矩阵乘法。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SignRot……
tldr: 提出SignRot方法，通过大规模离群值感知的符号调整旋转，解决大语言模型量化中大规模离群值引起的激活分布碎片化问题，并克服了下投影输入处旋转必须在线应用的训练难题。
en_tdlr: SignRot introduces a massive outlier-aware sign-adjusted rotation for LLM quantization, addressing fragmented activation distributions caused by massive outliers and overcoming the challenge that online rotation must be applied at inference time in the down-projection input.
